notes: 10004494 (Rompani 2017, PMID:28231464): all three summary quotes are substrings of the already-cited quote 10004494_03dd7881 (anatomical_location and nt_type) -> skipped_duplicate_quote.
4524072 (Guido 2018 review, PMID:28965501): general statements about retinal convergence onto dLGN thalamocortical neurons; nothing specific to the combination mode -> skipped_not_this_node.

Both written entries are reviews (same Visual Neuroscience special issue) and support multi-type / multi-RGC convergence in dLGN generally; neither names the combination mode. No independent primary study of combination-mode cells exists in this corpus; Rompani 2017 remains the sole primary source.

Possible tension with the node definition: 36416152 ("mature LGN neurons receive input from three or fewer RGCs") and 15010690 / 255986294 ("by 3 weeks of age a single relay neuron receives input from only one to three RGCs", physiological EPSP-based convergence estimates) describe low convergence consistent with relay mode, not 6-36 RGC combination mode. Not cited here; curator may want to note the methodological discrepancy (physiology vs transsynaptic rabies tracing) in node notes.

4807205 quote's argument comes from binocularly innervated neurons; recorded in scope that it does not specifically support the monocular combination mode (cf. dlgn_binocular_combination_mode_principal_neuron).
Remaining summaries concern X/Y/W morphology, core/shell, interneurons, development, or other circuits -> skipped (LOW relevance counted under skipped_low_relevance).
